tool.name: OGS: queryMesh
tool.command: ln -sf '$mesh_file' 'mesh_file.vtu'; queryMesh #if str($element_id) --element-id '$element_id' #end if #if str($node_id) --node-id '$node_id' #end if $show_node_with_max_elements 'mesh_file.vtu' > '$stdout_log'

param.label: element id
param.help: element ID (may be repeated; the wrapper passes one value)

param.label: node id
param.help: node ID (may be repeated; the wrapper passes one value)

param.label: show node with max elements
param.help: show a node having the max number of connected elements
